stem:
The table lists some organic acids and their $pK_a$ values.

| acid | formula | $pK_a$ |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| ethanoic acid | $\text{CH}_3\text{CO}_2\text{H}$ | 4.76 |
| chloroethanoic acid | $\text{ClCH}_2\text{CO}_2\text{H}$ | 2.86 |
| aminoethanoic acid (glycine) | $\text{H}_2\text{NCH}_2\text{CO}_2\text{H}$ | 9.87 |

parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.text: State the relationship between $pK_a$ and the strength of an acid.

parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.text: State the mathematical relationship between $pK_a$ and the acidity constant $K_a$.

parts.label: (a)(iii)
parts.text: Give reasons for why the $pK_a$ value for chloroethanoic acid is **smaller** than that for ethanoic acid.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.text: Use the zwitterionic structure for aminoethanoic acid (glycine) in aqueous solution to write an equation for its dissociation giving $\text{H}^+\text{(aq)}$ ions.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: Calculate the pH of a $0.100\text{ mol dm}^{-3}$ solution of aminoethanoic acid.
